item.title: India: BHASHINI Leads National Push for Inclusive Multilingual AI
item.description: The Digital India BHASHINI Division is actively advancing AI-driven multilingual tools and standardised geospatial data to enhance governance, digital inclusion and citizen-centric services across India.

item.title: Hong Kong: Smart Automation Boosts EV Battery Recycling
item.description: Hong Kong is developing a smart, fully automated production line to recycle end-of-life electric vehicle batteries into black mass, strengthening green manufacturing, resilience, and the circular economy.

item.title: The Philippines: iMessage Simplifies Transactions, Builds Confidence
item.description: The SEC has expanded its digital services, including the iMessage Online Ticketing System and SEC-ZERO, to streamline business registration, post-registration processes and investor protection.

item.title: Singapore: Driving SME Growth with Digital Transformation, AI
item.description: Singapore’s SMEs are encouraged to adopt practical AI and digital tools, continuously develop skills, strong capabilities and foster experimentation to drive growth, competitiveness and future-ready businesses.

item.title: Malaysia: Monash University Advances Smart Urban Agriculture
item.description: Monash University Malaysia has partnered with industry to develop innovative smart, data-driven urban farming systems that boost sustainability, efficiency and climate resilience in dense city environments.

item.title: Australia: Swinburne Accelerates Industry-Ready Innovation
item.description: Swinburne University of Technology has secured more than US$1.6 million in funding to translate applied research into industry-ready solutions spanning aerospace manufacturing, critical metals recovery, low-emission steel and advanced protective equipment.

item.title: Vietnam: Driving Global On-Chain Finance Cooperation at WEF
item.description: Vietnam’s GOE Alliance actively promotes on-chain financial infrastructure at Davos 2026, signing strategic MoUs to advance cross-border payments, crypto solutions and global digital finance collaboration.

item.title: Hong Kong: AI Maps the Evolution of Oxygen-Respiring Bacteria
item.description: Hong Kong researchers have used machine learning to trace when bacteria first evolved oxygen respiration, revealing hidden patterns and evolutionary trends and uncovering new insights into early life on Earth.

item.title: India: AI Strategy Rests on Deployment, RoI, Ethical Governance
item.description: At the WEF in Davos, Minister Vaishnaw outlined India’s AI strategy, emphasising large-scale diffusion, economic returns and techno-legal governance to ensure ethical and practical deployment across sectors.

item.title: Singapore: Global-First Framework for Responsible Agentic AI
item.description: Singapore has launched the world’s first Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI, providing organisations with guidance to deploy autonomous AI systems responsibly, safely and with human accountability.
